name: Diaspora & Heritage Return
audience: Afghan diaspora families and heritage travelers
summary: Return journeys planned from Kabul — family, heritage, and practical logistics around current access.
description: Planning patterns for diaspora families reconnecting with origins: elders, children, language, pace, and practical support. Personal history informs how we listen; it is not an access guarantee. This is not a leisure tour package.
examples_of_support: Family pacing; multi-generation planning; language-aware guiding; visits shaped around relatives and heritage places where currently workable
possible_regions: By family context — often Kabul and linked provinces
planning_notes: Share family context, pace, timing, and must-consider places. We reply from Kabul with what is workable.
accommodation_note: Family-friendly lodging where available; confirmed during planning.
availability_note: Inquiry-led — no fixed tour package dates or published price.

name: Veterans, Contractors & Diplomats
summary: Return visits for veterans, contractors, and diplomats — route-aware timing, not a brochure template.
description: Purpose-scoped return travel: former duty locations, personal objectives, privacy, and current conditions. Distinct from leisure tour packages and from specialist media/research work.
examples_of_support: Quiet routing; flexible day shape; privacy-conscious guiding; coordination around former workplaces or regions when access allows
possible_regions: By personal history and current access
planning_notes: Share goals, privacy preferences, and timing. We plan honestly around conditions — no promised access to every former site.
